free_tier_limits: Free plan daily quotas (via UI or API): 50 private scans, 1,000 unlisted scans, 5,000 public scans, 1,000 search requests, 1,000 result requests; per-minute/hour caps also apply (see /user/quotas/).
paid_plans: API Only Automate from $5,000/yr; Professional $1,250/mo ($12,500/yr); Enterprise $2,500/mo ($25,000/yr); Ultimate $5,000/mo ($50,000/yr). 30-day commercial trials available.
rate_limits: Per-action quotas with separate minute, hour, and day windows; HTTP 429 when exceeded; exact limits via GET https://urlscan.io/user/quotas/ (or /api/v1/quotas) and X-Rate-Limit-* response headers. Fixed-window resets at full minute/hour and midnight UTC; only HTTP 200 counts.
